attributes.board_name: Hawaii Board of Veterinary Medicine (DCCA Professional and Vocational Licensing)

rules.alternatives: Voluntary national credentialing (VTNE) or association certification; its CE rules are not state law.
rules.notes: Hawaii does not license or register veterinary technicians; no state CE applies. The Board of Veterinary Medicine's list of license types contains only «Veterinarian» (HRS ch. 471).
